nodes.label: Explore Events Public/Internal Variant Pattern
nodes.rationale: A single explore-events component renders different headers, empty states and pagination sizing depending on a `variant` input ('public' vs 'internal'), reusing one component across the landing page and internal my-events context instead of duplicating markup.

nodes.label: My Events publicLayout Toggle
nodes.rationale: Conditionally renders site-header/footer only when publicLayout is true, so the same My Events shell works both as a standalone public-facing route and embedded inside the internal app shell.

nodes.label: External User Restricted Navigation
nodes.rationale: When isExternalUser() is true, the header hides most nav links (keeping only Home/Explore Events) and swaps the login/apply CTA for a Logout button, restricting external accounts to a narrower navigation surface than public visitors.

nodes.label: In-memory only, no artificial latency
nodes.rationale: Server resets to seed state every restart with no disk writes and immediate reliable responses, async/Promise-shaped so swapping in-memory store for a real DB client is a drop-in change later.

nodes.label: Application Cancellation Deadline Policy
nodes.rationale: Submitters and co-owners can cancel an application only up to N days before the event date; after the deadline the application becomes read-only, preventing late-stage disruption to vendor/department commitments.

nodes.label: High Pax Threshold Policy
nodes.rationale: Events exceeding this attendee threshold require additional review by the F&B Reviewer and CFO before Department Review, adding an escalation branch to the approval workflow.

nodes.label: Proposal Reviewer Workflow Actions (Approve/Resubmit/Reject/Cancel)
nodes.rationale: A single shared reviewer comment textarea feeds three distinct actions (approve, resubmit-to-applicant, reject), with comment validation requirements differing per action (required for reject/resubmit, optional for approve), centralizing the review decision UI across proposal stages.

nodes.label: F&B role merge (FmbReviewer + FmbManager -> fmb)
nodes.rationale: The FmbReviewer/FmbManager split was a mistake representing one real job; merged into a single 'fmb' role owning high-pax review, F&B request review, and Mineral Water/Dietary dropdowns.

nodes.label: Fully data-driven RBAC rationale
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded branching in role-navigation.ts, workflow.service.js, and role-labels.js meant adding a department or changing reviewer logic required editing multiple files; the redesign makes Users, Units, Roles, and Page Visibility fully admin-managed from the UI with no code changes needed for routine org changes.

nodes.label: F&B job merge into head-of-department
nodes.rationale: There is no separate 'fmb' or 'cafeteria-manager' role; the F&B reviewer job is performed entirely by whoever holds head-of-department on the food_beverage_services unit, correcting an earlier mistaken split of one real job.

nodes.label: One head per unit constraint
nodes.rationale: A unit may have at most one head-of-school or head-of-department assignment at a time, hard blocked with a toast rather than silently replacing an existing head, to prevent ambiguous review authority.

nodes.label: Protected vs custom role distinction
nodes.rationale: The 9 seed roles are permanently protected (role_code, is_unit_scoped, unit-eligibility rule immutable, never deletable) so core workflow routing can't be broken by admin edits, while custom roles beyond these 9 remain fully editable/deletable.

nodes.label: School detection by substring match
nodes.rationale: No unit_kind column exists; a unit is treated as a School purely by checking whether unit.code contains 'school', kept as an internal backend helper never exposed as an admin-facing field.

nodes.label: Soft-delete with 7-day auto-purge
nodes.rationale: Roles and Units use soft-delete to archived_at state (hidden, grants no permissions) restorable by admin, auto-purged after 7 days if not restored, giving a recovery window against accidental deletion.

nodes.label: Unit + Level identity model
nodes.rationale: Replaces flat per-department role strings with two independent fields, unit_code and function_level, so a person's unit and level can never contradict each other since they are no longer encoded in one field that can drift out of sync with a separate unit assignment.

nodes.label: Soft-Delete / Restore Pattern for Managed Options
nodes.rationale: Uses a toggled 'Deleted' view backed by a separate deletedConfig/deletedRecords data source, letting admins restore items rather than permanently destroying them immediately.
nodes.norm_label: soft-delete / restore pattern for managed options

nodes.label: Club Category Soft-Delete With 7-Day Grace Period
nodes.rationale: Deleted categories remain restorable for 7 days ('daysRemaining' shown in UI) before permanent removal, preventing accidental irreversible loss of taxonomy data referenced elsewhere in the system.
nodes.norm_label: club category soft-delete with 7-day grace period

nodes.label: Backend owns the workflow (design principle)
nodes.rationale: Frontend sends actions and renders whatever state comes back; backend determines current step, authorization, next state, and history so the frontend is never trusted with authorization decisions.

nodes.label: Campus Tour trimmed to Starting Point only
nodes.rationale: Tour Area and Campus Map tables/columns/fields dropped entirely from both schema and frontend to simplify Campus Tour requests.
nodes.norm_label: campus tour trimmed to starting point only

nodes.label: HOS/HOD self-review skip rule
nodes.rationale: If the applicant is HOS/HOD of their own unit, hos_hod_review is skipped and F&B reviews next unconditionally; CFO still reviews after F&B if pax also exceeds HIGH_PAX_THRESHOLD.

nodes.label: Mineral Water merged into F&B task
nodes.rationale: Mineral Water Logo/Normal is not a separate department lane; F&B reviews food and water together as one task, though option lookup tables remain separate.
nodes.norm_label: mineral water merged into f&b task

nodes.label: Design Principle: backend owns the workflow
nodes.rationale: The frontend displays state, shows available actions, and sends actions but is never trusted to decide who can act; the backend determines the current step, validates authorization, decides the next step/responsible party, updates status, and records history.
nodes.norm_label: design principle: backend owns the workflow

nodes.label: Design Principle: manager-configured options are snapshotted
nodes.rationale: When an applicant picks a manager-configured dropdown option, the system copies the relevant fields into the request-specific table so that if a manager edits or deletes the option later, already-submitted requests keep their original snapshotted values and history doesn't change retroactively.
nodes.norm_label: design principle: manager-configured options are snapshotted

nodes.label: Inbox / Ongoing / History visibility model
nodes.rationale: Inbox/My Task shows only items where it's currently the user's turn to act; Ongoing shows items the user is involved with but not their turn (read-only); History shows completed items, with department staff only ever seeing approved ones since the decision is already made by the time it reaches them.

nodes.label: Cafeteria Staff shared inbox mechanism
nodes.rationale: assignment_mode='shared_pool' means the first staff member to claim a fulfilment task owns it and it leaves everyone else's inbox, avoiding pre-assignment overhead.

nodes.label: department_review parallel independent tasks
nodes.rationale: One request_task per selected requirement runs in parallel and independently; departments cannot reject outright, only resubmit-with-comment, so one department resubmitting doesn't affect others.

nodes.label: workflow.service.js hasRole update
nodes.rationale: Every function_level==='manager'/isManagerOfUnit check becomes hasRole(userId,'head-of-department',unitCode) || hasRole(userId,'head-of-school',unitCode); isHosHodOfUnit keeps its name for external callers but delegates to the new helper; FLAT_ROLE_FOR_REQUIREMENT.fmb stays as a routing token, not a user role.

nodes.label: role-navigation.ts navTreeFor replacement
nodes.rationale: ROLE_NAVIGATION static map and unitNavigationFor() are deleted in favor of navigationFor(user) calling the backend's /nav-tree, so nav_page becomes the single source of truth for the sidebar instead of hardcoded TypeScript.

nodes.label: applicant role deletion rationale
nodes.rationale: The applicant role is deleted entirely; every existing user with this role is migrated to student since applicants were conceptually always School-affiliated members submitting proposals.

nodes.label: generic staff role deletion rationale
nodes.rationale: The unscoped 'General Staff' role is deleted because every real staff member should belong to a School (as lecturer) or a Service department (as staff-level); unresolvable users are surfaced in a migration report rather than guessed.

nodes.label: users.role generic level marker compatibility field
nodes.rationale: role still needs a value for unit-scoped users so existing code reading users.role doesn't break everywhere at once; role stores the same string as function_level as a legacy/display-compat column while function_level is the new source of truth.
nodes.norm_label: users.role generic level marker compatibility field

nodes.label: School unit-kind warning note
nodes.rationale: If 'school' appears anywhere in Unit Name or the derived Unit Code, a non-blocking inline warning appears since this will be treated as an academic School with HOS/HOD + Lecturer + Student levels, letting the admin correct Unit Kind if wrong without blocking save.

nodes.label: Unit Code auto-derived read-only field
nodes.rationale: Unit Code is read-only and computed live from Unit Name on both client preview and server (never accepted as free client input) to guarantee client and server never disagree on the derivation.

nodes.label: Records Hub Conditional Tab Visibility (tasks/requests/club-requests)
nodes.rationale: Shows Tasks/Requests/Club Requests tabs conditionally per-role so different internal roles (staff, department reviewers, club admins) see only the record types relevant to them, sharing one hub shell via router-outlet.

nodes.label: Shared Component Library Live Showcase Pattern
nodes.rationale: A private development reference page renders live instances of every shared component (form-field, data-table, pagination, site-header, etc.) via a @switch on item.key, giving developers a searchable, categorized catalog and usage snippet for reuse instead of separate static documentation.
nodes.norm_label: shared component library live showcase pattern

nodes.label: Content-Projection Slot Composition Pattern (workspaceHeader/Controls/Table/Mobile)
nodes.rationale: Uses named ng-content slots (workspaceHeader, workspaceControls, workspaceTable, workspaceEmptyState, workspaceMobile) so internal-data-page can compose header/search/filter/table/mobile-list pieces into one shell while still owning shared pagination footer logic centrally.

nodes.label: Proposal Review viewKind Routing (applicant/reviewer/department)
nodes.rationale: Selects which review UI (applicant resubmit flow, reviewer view, or department view) to render based on the current user's relationship to the proposal, allowing one page to serve multiple roles.
